title_zh: 几何图形变成品牌文字
changes_from_source: 品牌替换为虚构 WAYPOINT；提供原创 Logo，固定字母数。
checks: 8 个图形和 8 个字母对应
brief_en: Make a 10-second ident for WAYPOINT. Eight colorful filled geometric shapes become the eight letters of WAYPOINT through a visible shape transformation. Use the supplied logo as a separate mark. In the last section the mark travels left to right and removes each letter only as it passes that letter. Keep the word readable before the exit.
brief_zh: 为 WAYPOINT 制作 10 秒品牌片头。8 个彩色实心几何图形通过可见形变成为 WAYPOINT 的 8 个字母。使用提供的独立标志，最后让标志从左到右移动，经过哪个字母才擦除哪个字母；退场前让完整品牌词清晰停留。
